overall_comment: Round 2 deep rewrite clears the high bar across all six categories. ALIGNMENT (4): capstone hits E1.1-E1.4 with named station per expectation; expanded_walkthrough cross-references Lessons 1-4 explicitly ('sort solids (L1), compose (L2), congruent (L3), map+move (L4)'). PEDAGOGICAL_DEPTH (4): trap is the no-verify / single-skill-fixation misconception with Battista (2007) levels of geometric reasoning cited by name in rationale; three diagnostic-branched recovery_moves (A: only one prior-day skill -> explicit 4-step checklist; B: solves but doesn't verify -> force overlay/recount; C: can verify but doesn't articulate -> sentence frame). INSTRUCTIONAL_BALANCE (4): puppets explicitly OPTIONAL with substitutions; NO-PREP 4-corner rotation in differentiation.for_movement_learners turns the room into the geometry workshop; 12/25/13 fits G3. CLARITY_VOICE (4): Tig+Coco capstone refrain 'SORT, COMPOSE, CONGRUENT, MAP — that's GEOMETRY!' appears in hook and exit_routine with a 3x class chant — children carry it between lessons; all success_criteria first-person 'I can'. MATHEMATICAL_AUTHENTICITY (4): STRATEGY COMPARE step at Stations 2/3 (overlay vs measure) lets geometers compare congruence-checking approaches with Battista (2007) cited — children invent/refine and class compares accuracy. LESSON_WORKSHEET_CONSISTENCY (4): worksheet's 3 parts each practise a named success criterion (Part 1 sort attributes, Part 2 decompose+congruent pair, Part 3 multistep map with quarter+half turns); transfer task varies station format (single integrated artifact rather than 4 separate stations) which is justified summative-artifact design; image_placeholders reference lesson manipulatives and Tig+Coco header. Strict bar met: zero scores below 3, zero scores at 3.
